top_signals.title: NYC Deputy Mayor on Jobs, Taxes, Grocery Stores
top_signals.summary: Julie Su, New York City deputy mayor for economic justice, talks about creating jobs, a new business advisory council, city-run grocery stores and Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s new  pied-à-terre tax on second homes. More than 31,000 property owners may get a new bill in the mail. She speaks to Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
